target_text: // Query heads scored per pass of qk_group: one accumulator register per head.
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

The second sentence ('A wider group ... is scored in passes of 16 heads') restates the `if constexpr (kv_mul > MAX_KV_MUL_16)` split at line 65 and the constant's own name. The first sentence carries the one fact the code does not say: why the value is 16 (one accumulator register per head).

Proposed:
```cpp
// Query heads scored per pass of qk_group: one accumulator register per head.
```
